details: The cryptocurrency market experienced a significant surge, with Bitcoin surpassing $72,000 for the first time since early June and Ethereum climbing above $2,300. This powerful rebound was largely driven by over $3 billion in short liquidations across the market, alongside positive catalysts such as the U.S. Treasury's expanded bond buyback program and supportive statements from President Trump regarding crypto regulation.
title: Crypto Market Soars: Bitcoin Breaks $72K, ETH Rallies Amid $3B Short Squeeze

details: The U.S. Treasury Department announced an expansion of its long-term Treasury buyback program, doubling operations to at least $4 billion each. This strategic move aims to ease market liquidity pressure, resulting in a decline in long-end Treasury yields and a weaker U.S. dollar, which is generally viewed as a positive development for risk assets, including cryptocurrencies.
title: US Treasury Expands Buyback Program, Bolstering Crypto Risk Appetite

details: President Trump met with prominent crypto executives at the White House, advocating for Congress to pass the "Clarity Act." This proposed legislation seeks to establish a clear regulatory framework for digital assets in the U.S. Trump highlighted that such a framework would maintain U.S. leadership in innovation and even hinted at the possibility of the U.S. government considering accumulating Bitcoin.
title: Trump Calls for Clarity Act Passage, Hints at US Bitcoin Accumulation

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) unveiled "Regulation Crypto Assets," a new proposed framework. This initiative aims to establish a bespoke regime for offering certain crypto asset investment contracts, providing exemptions from traditional Securities Act registration. The proposal includes tailored offering exemptions and a conditional investment contract safe harbor to streamline capital raising for crypto projects.
title: SEC Proposes New "Regulation Crypto Assets" for Tailored Offerings

details: U.S. spot Ethereum Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs) experienced substantial inflows on August 20, attracting over $220 million in fresh capital. This marked a continuation of a four-day winning streak for these funds. BlackRock's ETHA product was a significant contributor, accounting for approximately $173 million of the total inflows, indicating robust institutional demand for Ethereum.
title: Ethereum ETFs See Significant Inflows, Boosting ETH's Rally
